--browser_type.help: The type of browser the input files belongto (supported types are Chrome, Brave)

--bucket.help: Alternate GCS bucket to download from. Must be in the following format gs://{BUCKET_NAME}/. Defaults to the BUCKET_NAME as specified in the config

--close_tasks.help: Close tasks based on Request ID or Task ID

--config_file.help: Load explicit config file. If specified it will ignore config files in other default locations (/etc/turbinia.conf, ~/.turbiniarc, or in paths referenced in environment variable TURBINIA_CONFIG_PATH)

--copy_only.help: Only copy disk and do not process with Turbinia. This only takes effect when a source --project is defined and can be run without any Turbinia server or workers configured.

--days_history.help: Number of days of history to to query results for

--debug_tasks.help: Show debug output for all supported tasks

--decryption_keys.help: Decryption keys to be passed in as  comma separated list. Each entry should be in the form type=key. (e.g. "-k password=123456,recovery_password=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX")

--dump_json.help: Dump JSON status output instead text. Compatible with -d, -u, -r and -t flags, but not others

--embedded_path.help: Path within the Persistent Disk that points to the raw image file

--engine.help: The graphviz engine used to generate the graph layout.  Specify "list" to list out the available engines.

--extrayara.help: Any additional Yara rules to be used

--filter_patterns_file.help: A file containing newline separated string patterns to filter text based evidence files with (in extended grep regex format). This filtered output will be in addition to the complete output

--folder.help: Specify a particular folder to be scanned

--force_evidence.help: Force evidence processing request in potentially unsafe conditions

--format.help: The format of the output file you wish to generate.  Specify "list" to list out the available output types.  More info is here: http://www.graphviz.org/doc/info/output.html

--full_report.help: Generate full markdown report instead of just a summary

--group.help: Attribute by which output will be grouped.

--group_id.help: Show Requests for given group ID. This command only shows the related requests and overview of their task status. Run --full_report for the full list of requests and their tasks.

--instance_id.help: Instance ID used to run tasks/requests. You must provide an instance ID if the task/request was not processed on the same instance as your config file.

--jobs_allowlist.help: An allowlist for Jobs that will be allowed to run (in CSV format, no spaces). This will not force them to run if they are not configured to. This is applied both at server start time and when the client makes a processing request. When applied at server start time the change is persistent while the server is running.  When applied by the client, it will only affect that processing request.

--jobs_blacklist.help: A blacklist for Jobs we will not allow to run

--jobs_denylist.help: A denylist for Jobs we will not allow to run.  See --jobs_allowlist help for details on format and when it is applied.

--jobs_whitelist.help: A whitelist for Jobs that we will allow to run (note that it will not force them to run).

--magic.help: A path under the rules path that contains File Magics

--minscore.help: Only rules with scores greater than this will be output

--mount_partition.help: The partition number as an integer to use when mounting the parent disk. Defaults to the first partition. Only affects mounting, and not what gets processed.

--num_lines.help: Maximum number of log lines to retrieve.

--password.help: Password for the APFS evidence.  If a recovery key is specified concurrently, password will be ignored.

--path.help: Path of file or directory to be uploaded.

--poll_interval.help: Number of seconds to wait between polling for task state info

--priority_filter.help: This sets what report sections are shown in full detail in report output.  Any tasks that have set a report_priority value equal to or lower than this setting will be shown in full detail, and tasks with a higher value will only have a summary shown.  The default is 20 which corresponds to "HIGH_PRIORITY"To see all tasks report output in full detail, set --priority_filter=100 or to see CRITICAL only set --priority_filter=10

--project.help: Project that the disk to process is associated with. If this is different from the project that Turbinia is running in, it will be copied to the Turbinia project.

--query.help: Filter expression to use to query Stackdriver logs.

--reason.help: Related ticket/incident ID for the evidence

--recipe.help: Name of Recipe to be employed on evidence

--recipe_config.help: Recipe configuration data passed in as comma separated key=value pairs (e.g. "-C key=value,otherkey=othervalue").  These will get passed to tasks as evidence config, and will also be written to the metadata.json file for Evidence types that write it

--recipe_path.help: Recipe file path to load and use.

--recovery_key.help: Recovery key for the APFS evidence.  Either recovery key or password must be specified.

--request_id.help: Gets statistics for a specific request.

--requests.help: Show all requests from a specified timeframe. The default timeframe is 7 days. Please use the -d flag to extend this.

--rules.help: Specify a particular path to a file or folder containing the Yara rules to use

--run_local.help: Run completely locally without any server or other infrastructure. This can be used to run one-off Tasks to process data locally.

--single_threaded.help: Run PSQ Worker in a single thread

--skip_recipe_validation.help: Do not perform recipe validation on the client.

--source.help: Description of the source of the evidence

--task.help: The name of a single Task to run locally (must be used with --run_local).

--task_id.help: Gets statistics for a specific task.

--testrules.help: Test the given rules for syntax validity and then exit

--use_celery.help: Pass this flag when using Celery/Kombu for task queuing and messaging (instead of Google PSQ/pubsub)

--user.help: Gets statistics for a specific user.

--wait.help: Wait to exit until all tasks for the given request have completed

--workers.help: Show Worker status information from a specified timeframe. The default timeframe is 7 days. Please use the -d flag to extend this. Additionaly, you can use the -a or --all_fields flag to retrieve the full output containing finished and unassigned worker tasks.

--zone.help: Geographic zone the disk exists in

compresseddirectory.help: Process a compressed tar file as Evidence (bulk processable)

directory.help: Process a directory as Evidence (bulk processable)

dumpgcs.help: Get Turbinia results from Google Cloud Storage.

googleclouddisk.help: Process Google Cloud Persistent Disk as Evidence (bulk processable)

googleclouddiskembedded.help: Process Google Cloud Persistent Disk with an embedded raw disk image as Evidence (bulk processable)

listjobs.help: List all available Jobs. These Job names can be used by --jobs_allowlist and --jobs_denylist
